title: preCICE Component Template (Docker Compose Service Fragment)
description: Schema for component template YAML files. These are Jinja2 templates that render into a single Docker Compose service definition. The rendered output follows a subset of the Docker Compose service specification. Note: Jinja2 template expressions ({{ ... }}, {% ... %}) are present in the raw files and will not validate against this schema directly — this schema describes the expected *structure* of the template.

build.description: Docker build configuration for the service image.

context.description: Build context path (Jinja2 template variable: {{ dockerfile_context }}).

args.description: Build arguments passed to Docker. Rendered from Jinja2 loop over build_arguments.

target.description: The Docker multi-stage build target to use (e.g., 'precice', 'openfoam_adapter', 'fenics_adapter').

depends_on.description: Service dependencies. Typically depends on the 'prepare' service.

volumes.description: Volume mounts for the service container.

command.description: The command to run inside the container. Typically a bash script that changes to the case directory and executes the run command.
